# AmazingHiring

> AmazingHiring is a tech recruiting platform providing candidate sourcing tools, Chrome extensions, and ATS integrations to help talent acquisition teams find and engage developers from GitHub, Stack Overflow, and LinkedIn.

The platform focuses on technical recruitment automation, offering sourcing solutions, data enrichment capabilities, and outreach tools. AmazingHiring serves recruiters and sourcing professionals looking to optimize their tech hiring workflows through integration with platforms like SmartRecruiters, Lever, and Greenhouse.

## Key Topics

- Candidate sourcing
- Tech recruiting
- ATS integration
- Chrome extension
- GitHub sourcing
- LinkedIn sourcing
- Stack Overflow
- Talent acquisition
- Developer recruitment
- Outreach automation
- Data enrichment
- Sourcing tools
- Boolean search
- Recruitment strategies
- Talent mapping

## Product Features & Tools

- [How to Source Tech Candidates with AmazingHiring Extension](https://amazinghiring.com/blog/how-to-source-tech-candidates-with-amazinghiring-extension): Tutorial for Chrome Extension to find profiles from GitHub, Stack Overflow
- [Find Candidates' Profiles from an Email on Any Website or SaaS Platform](https://amazinghiring.com/blog/find-candidates-profiles-from-an-email-on-any-website-or-saas-platform): Chrome extension update for email-to-profile enrichment in Lever, Greenhouse
- [AmazingHiring product updates](https://amazinghiring.com/blog/amazinghiring-product-updates): New features for AmazingHiring: ATS integration and outreach automation
- [Increase the Number of Hires From Your Candidate Database](https://amazinghiring.com/blog/increase-the-number-of-hires-from-your-ats): ATS optimization via Data Enrichment with GitHub, LinkedIn profiles

## Sourcing Strategies & Best Practices

- [Sourcing Hacks Volume 2](https://amazinghiring.com/blog/sourcing-hacks-2): 15 ready-to-use tech sourcing hacks and recruitment productivity tips
- [How to Source on a Budget: Simple Tips for Better Results — by Nadine Naidoo of MatcHR](https://amazinghiring.com/blog/how-to-source-on-a-budget-simple-tips-for-better-results): Budget-friendly sourcing tactics using free tools and personal branding
- [How to Be Hands-on While Sourcing for Tech Talent: Social Sourcing in 2022](https://amazinghiring.com/blog/how-to-be-hands-on-while-sourcing-for-tech-talent-part-2-social-sourcing): Thoughtworks Agile Sourcing strategy for IT candidates via social channels
- [First Signs You Need a Sourcing Team in Your Organization](https://amazinghiring.com/blog/first-signs-you-need-a-sourcing-team-in-your-organization): Guide for building sourcing function in fast-paced organizations
- [Candidate Sourcing and Outreach Automation with PhantomBuster & AmazingHiring](https://amazinghiring.com/blog/candidate-sourcing-and-outreach-automation-with-phantombuster-amazinghiring): Workshop on PhantomBuster integration for recruitment workflow automation
